Definition: apparently from the base of G3796 and G5610; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.
BiblicalUsage: Ripe fruit is the picture of luxury in Revelation. When Babylon falls, the fruits that her soul lusted after are departed from her, and all things which were dainty and goodly are gone, and she shall find them no more at all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fruits of Babylon teach a hard lesson: everything the soul lusts after can be taken away in a single hour.
